notes: The hanging-start scenario keeps the event loop alive with setInterval: with a bare never-settling promise Node exits code 13 (unsettled top-level await), which the parent correctly reports as reason exited, not timeout. Options are validated before dataDir is created, so the option-error test also asserts no engine.log and no pids.log. Every spawned child is killed by pid in finally, so no child leaks into the concurrent e2e default-port test.
